verdict.line: You lose if you get Death Gripped into Q range before level 6; you win by refusing every fight until P (Adaptive Defense) is up and Trinity Force finishes.

brief.thesis: Mordekaiser's E (Death Grip) removes Camille's biggest advantage — her mobility — by yanking her into his W-empowered Q (Obliterate) cleave the instant she commits Hookshot near a wall. That's exactly why OP.GG marks this lane and the solo-kill race as his. But the 51.3% Camille win rate over 382 games says the math flips once Trinity Force comes online, because Morde has almost no way to punish a Camille who declines to fight before her shield is up or before his E is spent.

theirWindow.when: when Death Grip is off cooldown
theirWindow.what: Do not dash Hookshot toward a wall he can stand near, and don't push the wave into his melee range — a landed E chains straight into Q (Obliterate) and an auto he can't miss.

yourWindow.when: when your P (Adaptive Defense) shield is active
yourWindow.what: This is your only clean trade window — engage with empowered Q (Precision Protocol) into auto, since the shield lets you eat his Q cleave for free while your damage goes through untouched.

powerCurve.note: Q cleave and range win short trades
Death Grip threatens every hookshot engage
Realm of Death makes all-ins deadly
Trinity Force closes the trading gap
Hydra and Death's Dance win extended fights

start.why: Runs 49.5% over 315 games and is the 67.3% pick here — the extra AD and sustain matter because you're going to be eating Q (Obliterate) pokes for several minutes before you can safely all-in.

boots.why: Picked 64.4% of the time at 47.5% win rate; the magic resist blunts his Q/E/R poke and ult damage, which matters more here than the slow resist since Death Grip isn't actually a slow or stun.

core.why: This is your power spike against him — it's the point on the curve (levels 9-13) where your trades stop losing to his Q cleave, and it's the first item in the highest win-rate path (59.4% over 64 games).
Gives you the sustained damage and wave clear to stop losing side-lane pressure to his Q farm, and keeps the same 59.4%-win build path intact.
Completes the highest-performing path; the damage-over-time conversion is what lets you survive trading into his Realm of Death burst once you're forced into it.

situational.when: you're behind on gold and need the wave clear and sustain before Hydra finishes
he's ahead and his Realm of Death all-in is threatening to burst you before you can respond
the game goes long and you need the extra ability haste to weave Hookshot and Ultimatum back into fights faster

runes.keystoneWhy: This is the 23.5%-pick, 51%-win page, and it fits the defensive shape of this lane — the per-attack heal and max-health growth offset his Q poke over the course of a fight you're not trying to win quickly.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the highest-picked combo here (68.4% pick, 48.5% win) and lets you punish him if he overextends E to poke before level 6, since he has no real sustain to out-heal Ignite that early; if you'd rather skip the lane entirely and scale through side-lane splitpush, Flash+Teleport runs a higher 44.6% pool win rate for that plan.

playing.title: Bait Death Grip into minions
playing.detail: Stand with a minion between you and Morde so a whiffed or blocked E burns his 14+ second cooldown at low rank without landing on you.

playing.title: Trade only under P shield
playing.detail: Only commit Q (Precision Protocol) or W (Tactical Sweep) into extended contact when your Adaptive Defense shield is active — outside of it his Q cleave wins every extended trade.

playing.title: Never Hookshot blind near walls
playing.detail: E (Hookshot) toward a wall he's standing near is a free Death Grip into Q for him — only use it to disengage or reposition, not to initiate, before you have a item lead.

playing.title: Play passive pre-6, spike post-Trinity
playing.detail: Avoid all extended fights before level 6 and again right after, since Realm of Death removes your ability to disengage; wait for Trinity Force to start pressuring him.

playing.title: Punish his Q cooldown after wave clear
playing.detail: Once he uses Q (Obliterate) to clear a wave, that's your window to step up and poke with Q before he can reset it.

playing.title: Don't fight through his ultimate
playing.detail: If he lands Realm of Death, you can't escape it — commit to winning the isolated 1v1 with your shield and healing item value rather than trying to flash or dash out.

playing.title: Splitpush once itemized
playing.detail: From level 9 onward, use your Trinity Force movement speed to out-rotate him on side waves rather than force skirmishes he still wins in a straight duel.

brief.patchCaveat: The build order, boots, runes, and summoner numbers above are measured from real OP.GG games on the current patch (16.18.1); the tactical reasoning about Death Grip timing, shield windows, and the power-spike sequencing is our own coaching judgment, not itself measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of being pulled by Mordekaiser’s (E)! Try to deal damage one-sidedly when Camille’s shield [P] is active!
